issues.reason: The oblique rule fixes the head as the preposition actually used and states outright that `During` renders only the word 'during' (the interval section adds only during/while/throughout), so the surface 'through' must take the head `Through`.

The plural-as-group half stands (Coordination & plurals routes a plural through `GroupOf`, as this very parse did for 'investigators'), but nothing emitted is false, ill-typed or over-asserted, and the modifier 'public' on a group would need the distributive rule, which cannot be emitted inside a seal — so the half that stands carries no licensed repair.

gaps_confirmed: non-intersective / modal adjective ('a potential outbreak'): the descriptive-modifier split types the witness as a real outbreak, and there is no carrier for a modifier that suspends the head noun's application

that-less reported clause in quotative inversion ('..., Harrison said'): the attitude section is scoped to a finite 'that'-complement and does not state that the bare reported clause routes to the seal-under-Theme pattern
new_gaps: non-veridical object of 'prevent': the prevented occurrence is typed and witnessed inside the sealed complement, yet the sentence's own content says it did not happen — no polarity carrier exists for the object of prevent/avert/avoid

a named holiday used as a temporal span ('through the Christmas holiday'): the entity carries `Member`/`Name` typing, but the instruction set does not say how a named time-span entity enters a temporal slot (bare `Time` filler vs preposition-named oblique)
repair_summary: Replaced (During sk_work_1 christmas) with (Through sk_work_1 christmas) inside the sealed Theme term; every other atom, symbol and ordering is unchanged.
